card.name: Montaña de Oro Sea Salt tortilla chips
card.origin: Based in San Luis Obispo, California
card.description: Taco Works chips with Montaña de Oro sea salt, made in San Luis Obispo. Open the bag when the guacamole is ready. Nobody needs a more complicated plan.

meet_the_maker.name: Taco Works
meet_the_maker.story: Taco Works started as a San Luis Obispo restaurant in 1976. Its tortilla chips became popular enough to outgrow the restaurant and become a business of their own. The Montaña de Oro line keeps things straightforward: white corn and salt. Give them a good bowl of guacamole.
